record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Function Theory of the Bergman Space
record.original_question: For the weighted biharmonic operator Delta (1 - |z|^2)^{-alpha} Delta on the unit disk D, is its Green function U_alpha(z, zeta) positive on D x D for every real parameter alpha with -1 < alpha ≤ 1?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.3. The Green function U_alpha(z, zeta) for the weighted biharmonic operator Delta (1 - |z|2)^{-alpha} Delta is positive on D x D for all real parameter values alpha having -1 < alpha ≤ 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disk. For a real parameter $\alpha$ with $-1<\alpha\le 1$, consider the weighted biharmonic operator
$$L_\alpha u(z) \;=\; \Delta\!\left((1-|z|^2)^{-\alpha}\,\Delta u(z)\right), \qquad z\in\mathbb{D},$$
where $\Delta$ is the Euclidean Laplacian. Let $U_\alpha(z,\zeta)$ denote the Green function of $L_\alpha$ on $\mathbb{D}$ with Dirichlet (clamped-plate) boundary conditions; that is, for each fixed $\zeta\in\mathbb{D}$, the function $z\mapsto U_\alpha(z,\zeta)$ satisfies
$$\Delta\!\left((1-|z|^2)^{-\alpha}\,\Delta_z U_\alpha(z,\zeta)\right) \;=\; \delta_\zeta(z) \quad \text{on } \mathbb{D},$$
together with the boundary conditions $U_\alpha(z,\zeta)=0$ and $\partial_{n} U_\alpha(z,\zeta)=0$ for $z\in\partial\mathbb{D}$.

Determine whether, for every real $\alpha$ with $-1<\alpha\le 1$,
$$U_\alpha(z,\zeta) \;>\; 0 \qquad \text{for all } (z,\zeta)\in \mathbb{D}\times\mathbb{D}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The positivity of the Green function for the weighted biharmonic operator $\Delta(1-|z|^2)^{-\alpha}\Delta$ on the unit disk has been established. Shimorin obtained an explicit integral formula proving positivity for $\alpha\in(-1,0)$, and constructive existence/positivity results were given for $\alpha\ge 0$, with $\alpha=1$ corresponding to Hedenmalm's earlier explicit formula. More generally, positivity holds whenever the weight is radial, logarithmically subharmonic, and area integrable, which covers $(1-|z|^2)^\alpha$ for $-1<\alpha\le 1$.

status_evidence.title: The Green function for the weighted biharmonic operator Δ(1−|z|^2)^{−α}Δ, and factorization of analytic functions
status_evidence.snippet: An explicit integral formula is obtained for the Green function of Δ(1−|z|^2)^{−α}Δ on the unit disk for α∈(−1,0), and the formula shows positivity of the Green function.
status_evidence.claim: Positivity proved for α∈(−1,0) via explicit formula (Shimorin).

status_evidence.title: A computation of Green functions for the weighted biharmonic operators Δ|z|^{−2α}Δ, with α>−1 (Hedenmalm)
status_evidence.snippet: Hedenmalm computes the Green function explicitly for related weighted biharmonic operators, providing the α=1 case.
status_evidence.claim: Explicit positivity for α=1 case stated by Hedenmalm.

status_evidence.title: Construction of Green functions for weighted biharmonic operators
status_evidence.snippet: Constructive proof of existence of the weighted biharmonic Green function Γα for α≥0, with positivity.
